scope: Current conversation-level research frontiers that are not yet represented as repository evidence
epistemic_rule: Conversation-only records remain conversation provenance; they cannot promote repository evidence or product-opportunity status.

transitions.pre_state: Research decisions/results exist partly as conversation narrative.
transitions.target_state: Durable canonical records preserve claims, evidence, experiments, artifacts, decisions, contradictions, gaps and lineage.
transitions.desired_delta: Continuation no longer depends on recalling prose; provenance becomes explicit.

transitions.pre_state: A labelled boundary-gluing instance is given without relying on maximum-matching deficiency/cut gain.
transitions.target_state: Perfect-matching feasibility is represented by the boundary matching family and gluing is decided by complementary feasible sets.
transitions.desired_delta: PM under labelled boundary gluing becomes a finite boundary signature decision.
transitions.evidence_boundary: Prior conversation recorded exhaustive n=4,5 enumeration with no SEA/strong-exchange counterexample and cited Wenzel as core source; repository evidence not asserted here.

transitions.pre_state: Residual demand D_i exceeds tolerance epsilon_i over horizon T.
transitions.target_state: Selected mechanisms provide sufficient aggregate rate to satisfy all residual tolerances under cost/budget constraints.
transitions.desired_delta: Automation/realization gap becomes a measurable rate-covering problem.
transitions.evidence_boundary: The model and R1-R7 code are user-supplied in the current conversation; no new execution result is asserted in this record.

transitions.pre_state: A structural problem has candidate factorization/history refinements but uncertain observation period.
transitions.target_state: Constraint solving/refinement identifies a consistent cyclic observation period with independently checked witnesses.
transitions.desired_delta: Ambiguous structural hypotheses become finite, testable state transitions.

transitions.pre_state: A compact recurrent/looped model architecture with ternary weights has design assumptions but incomplete empirical comparison.
transitions.target_state: Architecture variants are benchmarked under fixed tasks/oracles with reproducible measurements.
transitions.desired_delta: Design claims become benchmark-supported or are killed without conflating parameter count with useful behavior.

boundary: This index is a continuation aid, not a substitute for repository evidence. Each entry requires a later source artifact or experiment before promotion.
